argv:
set -e
printf 'begin	'; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf 'device	'; getprop ro.product.device
printf 'kernel	'; uname -r
printf 'uid	'; id -u
for name in soc_id hw_platform platform_subtype platform_subtype_id platform_version; do
    test -f /sys/devices/soc0/$name
    printf '%s	' "$name"
    od -An -v -tx1 /sys/devices/soc0/$name | tr -d ' 
'
    printf '
'
done
printf 'end	'; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
